data.name: Cambridge Carbon Capture
data.description: Cambridge Carbon Capture Ltd was a UK startup developing the CO2LOC process, a two-stage ex-situ mineralisation technology reacting magnesium hydroxide with CO2 to produce magnesium carbonate for industrial and construction uses. The company entered creditors' voluntary liquidation on 3 June 2025, with KRE Corporate Recovery Limited appointed as liquidators.
